atoms.exact_source_text: A contested Away MEET lasts one to four rounds.
atoms.normalized_claim: A contested Away MEET lasts one to four rounds.

atoms.exact_source_text: The entry Approach establishes the first group result.
atoms.normalized_claim: The entry Approach establishes the first group result.

atoms.exact_source_text: A clean resolution closes the scene.
atoms.normalized_claim: A clean resolution closes the scene.

atoms.exact_source_text: A costly, partial, or opposed result opens a Turn: a concrete immediate problem produced by the fiction rather than a second universal menu.
atoms.normalized_claim: A costly, partial, or opposed result opens a Turn, defined as a concrete immediate problem produced by the fiction rather than a second universal menu.

atoms.exact_source_text: The hawk turns toward the kit carrier
atoms.normalized_claim: Example of a Protect Turn type: the hawk turns toward the kit carrier.

atoms.exact_source_text: Choose who accepts Exposure to shield another.
atoms.normalized_claim: The function of a Protect Turn is to choose who accepts Exposure to shield another.

atoms.exact_source_text: The medicine bundle falls beneath the guardrail
atoms.normalized_claim: Example of a Recover Turn type: the medicine bundle falls beneath the guardrail.

atoms.exact_source_text: Decide whether the objective is worth a new risk.
atoms.normalized_claim: The function of a Recover Turn is to decide whether the objective is worth a new risk.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Citizen goes tharn or becomes separated
atoms.normalized_claim: Example of a Rescue Turn type: a Citizen goes tharn or becomes separated.

atoms.exact_source_text: Choose who can go back, or Withdraw and accept the cost.
atoms.normalized_claim: The function of a Rescue Turn is to choose who can go back, or Withdraw and accept the cost.

atoms.exact_source_text: The party can force a better group result by staying in danger
atoms.normalized_claim: Example of a Press Turn type: the party can force a better group result by staying in danger.

atoms.exact_source_text: A named Citizen deliberately raises personal Exposure.
atoms.normalized_claim: The function of a Press Turn is that a named Citizen deliberately raises personal Exposure.

atoms.exact_source_text: New information changes which Approaches remain lit
atoms.normalized_claim: Example of a Reframe Turn type: new information changes which Approaches remain lit.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Guest, tool, relationship, or discovered weakness opens or closes possibility.
atoms.normalized_claim: The function of a Reframe Turn is that a Guest, tool, relationship, or discovered weakness opens or closes possibility.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tharn is an acute break, not a high damage bar.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tharn is defined as an acute break, not a high damage bar.

atoms.exact_source_text: When a Citizen goes tharn, the scene briefly narrows to that Citizen—sound, breath, pulse, fixation—and returns with changed options.
atoms.normalized_claim: When a Citizen goes tharn, the scene briefly narrows to that Citizen (sound, breath, pulse, fixation) and returns with changed options.

atoms.exact_source_text: The next Turn is forced toward rescue, protection, withdrawal, or deliberate abandonment.
atoms.normalized_claim: The next Turn after a tharn event is forced toward rescue, protection, withdrawal, or deliberate abandonment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tharn cannot be cleared by EMBODY; only safety, care, and time can resolve it.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tharn cannot be cleared by EMBODY; only safety, care, and time can resolve it.

atoms.exact_source_text: Scene terrain may alter the terms of an Approach, but the player does not place Citizens into cover squares, assign facing, choose initiative, or target individual enemies.
atoms.normalized_claim: Scene terrain may alter the terms of an Approach, but the player does not place Citizens into cover squares, assign facing, choose initiative, or target individual enemies.

atoms.exact_source_text: The party remains one body on the front end; individuality appears through choice, Exposure, and consequence on the back end.
atoms.normalized_claim: The party remains one body on the front end, with individuality appearing through choice, Exposure, and consequence on the back end.

atoms.exact_source_text: Exposure is the Away economy of possibility.
atoms.normalized_claim: Exposure is defined as the Away economy of possibility.

atoms.exact_source_text: It records how far a Citizen has placed themselves beyond ordinary safety—not as a visible numeric stat, but as an internally tracked pressure expressed through descriptive state, named Conditions, history, and altered outcome tails.
atoms.normalized_claim: Exposure records how far a Citizen has placed themselves beyond ordinary safety, not as a visible numeric stat but as an internally tracked pressure expressed through descriptive state, named Conditions, history, and altered outcome tails.
